info.title: Blockchain Lab Open Data API
info.description: Free, static, CORS-enabled JSON datasets for blockchain builders: chains, DeFi TVL, stablecoins, yields, bridges, DEX volumes, fees, L2 metrics (L2BEAT), security incidents, OFAC-sanctioned addresses, public RPC health, hackathons, events, whitepapers, glossary, grants, EIPs/ERCs/BIPs. Versioned (/v1, semver schema_version, JSON Schema per dataset). Rebuilt nightly from public sources. Built by Blockchain Lab — https://blockchainlab.com

license.name: Code MIT; data belongs to each named source

get.summary: Dataset catalogue

200.description: List of datasets with counts, sources and generation time

get.summary: Bitcoin Improvement Proposals index parsed from bitcoin/bips.
get.description: Source: github.com/bitcoin/bips (https://github.com/bitcoin/bips). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Cross-chain and canonical bridges ranked by TVL (DefiLlama bridge categories).
get.description: Source: DefiLlama protocols (bridge categories) (https://api.llama.fi/protocols). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: EVM chain registry: chain IDs, native currency, public RPC endpoints and explorers.
get.description: Source: chainid.network (ethereum-lists/chains) (https://chainid.network/chains.json). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: DeFi TVL by chain (USD). Snapshot from DefiLlama.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama (https://api.llama.fi/v2/chains). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: DEX trading volume by protocol (top 300 by 24h). Snapshot from DefiLlama.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama overview/dexs (https://api.llama.fi/overview/dexs). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: EIPS index (number, title, status, type, category) parsed from ethereum/EIPs.
get.description: Source: github.com/ethereum/EIPs (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/tree/master/EIPS). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: ERCS index (number, title, status, type, category) parsed from ethereum/ERCs.
get.description: Source: github.com/ethereum/ERCs (https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/tree/master/ERCS). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Upcoming blockchain events from the Blockchain Lab feeds.
get.description: Source: Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds (ethglobal.com/events; devpost.com (blockchain hackathons)) (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/main/feeds/events/latest.json). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Protocol fees by protocol (top 300 by 24h). Snapshot from DefiLlama.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama overview/fees (https://api.llama.fi/overview/fees). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Plain-language blockchain glossary from blockchainlab.com (concepts, protocol profiles, failure classes, stack layers).
get.description: Source: blockchainlab.com/learn/glossary (https://blockchainlab.com/learn/glossary). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Directory of blockchain ecosystem grant / funding programmes with official links. Curated by Blockchain Lab; link status re-checked nightly. No amounts are listed — read each programme's own page.
get.description: Source: Official programme pages (curated) (https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-api/blob/main/data/grants.json). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Open and upcoming blockchain hackathons (Devpost, ETHGlobal).
get.description: Source: Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds (devpost.com/api/hackathons (theme Blockchain, open+upcoming); ethglobal.com/events (future hackathons); X posts (leads only)) (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/main/feeds/hackathons/latest.json). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Ethereum L2/L3 scaling projects: stage, category, stack, risk summary and Total Value Secured breakdown. From L2BEAT.
get.description: Source: L2BEAT public API (https://l2beat.com/api/scaling/summary). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Top 500 DeFi protocols by TVL (USD), excluding CEXs. Snapshot from DefiLlama; not investment advice.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama (https://api.llama.fi/protocols). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Health of popular free public RPC endpoints (EVM chains, Solana, Bitcoin): reachability, latency, block lag vs best endpoint, chain-ID check. Probed from a GitHub Actions runner (US) at build time.
get.description: Source: Blockchain Lab probe (GitHub Actions) (https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-api/blob/main/scripts/build.mjs). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Digital currency addresses on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list, per asset. Extracted daily from the official SDN XML by github.com/0xB10C. Compliance screening aid only — verify against the official list.
get.description: Source: OFAC SDN list via 0xB10C/ofac-sanctioned-digital-currency-addresses (https://github.com/0xB10C/ofac-sanctioned-digital-currency-addresses/tree/lists). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Public record of crypto hacks and exploits: date, protocol, technique, classification, amount lost/returned. From DefiLlama's hacks database.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama hacks (https://api.llama.fi/hacks). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Stablecoins by circulating supply with price, peg mechanism and 1d/7d/30d supply change. Snapshot from DefiLlama.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama stablecoins (https://stablecoins.llama.fi/stablecoins?includePrices=true). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Blockchain Lab research corpus — whitepaper metadata (no paper text). Original sources linked.
get.description: Source: Blockchain Lab /api/v1/papers (https://blockchainlab.com/api/v1/papers). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.

get.summary: Top 500 DeFi yield pools by TVL (>= $10m) with APY, base/reward split, IL risk. Snapshot from DefiLlama; APYs change constantly and are not advice.
get.description: Source: DefiLlama yields (https://yields.llama.fi/pools). Rebuilt nightly by GitHub Actions.
